---
title: "2022 Florida Governor Race by Precinct"
author: "Student"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tigris)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

# 1. Load precinct-level results
raw_precincts <- read_csv("data/20221108__fl__general__precinct.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# 2. Filter for Governor race
gov_data <- raw_precincts |>
  filter(
    office == "Governor",
    !candidate %in% c("OverVotes", "UnderVotes", "WriteinVotes")
  ) |>
  group_by(county, precinct) |>
  mutate(
    total_votes = sum(votes),
    pct = ifelse(total_votes > 0, votes / total_votes, 0)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

# 3. Determine winner per precinct
precinct_winners <- gov_data |>
  slice_max(votes, by = c(county, precinct), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(prec_id = str_extract(precinct, "^[A-Za-z0-9]+") |> str_remove("^0+"))

# 4. Build hover popup table
precinct_popups <- gov_data |>
  arrange(county, precinct, desc(votes)) |>
  group_by(county, precinct) |>
  summarize(
    table_html = paste0(
      "<div style='font-family: sans-serif;'>",
      "<strong>", first(county), " County</strong><br/>",
      "<small>", first(precinct), "</small><br/><br/>",
      "<table style='width:100%; border-spacing: 4px;'>",
      paste0(
        "<tr><td>", candidate, " (", party, ")</td>",
        "<td align='right'><strong>", scales::comma(votes), "</strong> (", scales::percent(pct, accuracy = 0.1), ")</td></tr>",
        collapse = ""
      ),
      "</table></div>"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(prec_id = str_extract(precinct, "^[A-Za-z0-9]+") |> str_remove("^0+"))

precinct_combined <- precinct_winners |>
  left_join(precinct_popups, by = c("county", "precinct", "prec_id"))

# 5. Fetch Florida voting districts (VTDs) and join with results
fl_fips <- fips_codes |>
  filter(state == "FL") |>
  mutate(county_clean = str_remove(county, " County"))

fl_vtds <- voting_districts(state = "FL", cb = TRUE, year = 2020, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  left_join(fl_fips |> select(county_code, county_clean), by = c("COUNTYFP20" = "county_code")) |>
  mutate(vtd_id = str_remove(VTDST20, "^0+")) |>
  inner_join(precinct_combined, by = c("county_clean" = "county", "vtd_id" = "prec_id")) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  st_simplify(dTolerance = 0.005, preserveTopology = TRUE)
```

## Interactive Precinct Map

Hover over any precinct to see the vote totals and percentages for each candidate.

```{r}
#| label: precinct-map
pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("DeSantis / Nuñez" = "#e41a1c", "Crist / Hernandez" = "#377eb8"),
  domain = fl_vtds$candidate
)

leaflet(fl_vtds, width = "100%", height = "650px") |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(candidate),
    fillOpacity = 0.75,
    color = "white",
    weight = 0.5,
    highlightOptions = highlightOptions(
      weight = 2,
      color = "#000",
      fillOpacity = 0.95,
      bringToFront = TRUE
    ),
    label = ~lapply(table_html, HTML),
    labelOptions = labelOptions(
      style = list("font-weight" = "normal", padding = "6px 8px"),
      direction = "auto"
    )
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = ~candidate,
    title = "Winner",
    opacity = 0.8
  )
```
